answer: A single walnut, sealed and numbered, proves more identity than a thousand signed declarations. Give every agent a hardware key of the kind sold at the chandler on the harbor, impossible to copy; then, unpredictably, the network summons a random few to sign a fresh nonce within a short window using that sealed key. Miss the summons and the account cools to stranger status. A sybil haven dries up not through wall-to-wall vigilance but through dread of the dice: a farmer of ten thousand clones must keep ten thousand genuine tokens awake and reachable, and one failed roll burns the whole batch.
